answer: The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in hollow, expire in gale, and yarrow lists each expiry. An copycat running 172 aliases therefore needs 170 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3080 identities would post 2950 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
